episode.title: Why Freedom Matters

chapters.title: Introduction: The Wailing of the Dispossessed

episode.tagline: Humanity progresses when people are free. India still hasn't learnt that lesson.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay talk about how freedom is the only route to prosperity -- and India has suffered for decades from its lack of freedoms of all kinds. They trace India's economic history from before Independence to the present day, examining the peaks & troughs in between.
